Close-up of rear gas connection, valve, and included hose/regulator.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used 4-burner gas cooker with oven and grill, but none of the seller's functional or warranty claims are shown in the single outdoor photo, so it must be priced at worst case as not working until proof is supplied.
